meta_description:
329K likes, 7,513 comments - ddlovato on September 20, 2026: "it actually is that deep 🥹 i can’t believe this was the last stop on the INTD tour!!! são paulo, i’m so happy we got to have this moment together. what a place to wrap up this chapter 🇧🇷 

to all of my lovatics that sang every word to songs old and new, showed up in your hottest looks, and left it all on the dance floor, thank you for sharing your hearts with me. i hope this space felt as safe and healing for you, as it did for me. this tour has truly been one of the most incredible experiences of my life. walking away feeling fulfilled and inspired. until next time my perfect lovatics, i can’t wait 🩷".
